🌴🔥 NEW LOCATION • NEW ENERGY • SAME SUMMER MAGIC! 🔥🌴
OPEN SUMMER FESTIVAL 2027
🌴 BEACH EDITION 🌴
☀️ WELCOME TO YOUR SUMMER EXPERIENCE!
Get ready for 4 unforgettable days of dance, music, sunshine, beach vibes and amazing people from all over the world!
From May 20th to 24th, 2027, Open Summer Festival takes you to an incredible new destination:
📍 BARCELÓ PUNTA UMBRÍA BEACH RESORT
🌴 Punta Umbría • Huelva • Spain
A spectacular beachfront resort where you can dance, relax, connect and celebrate together in the heart of the Spanish summer.
